Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a TMT 10-plex labeling strategy with MS3-based quantification on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos. The proteomics assay is an AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) targeting the CD44 interactome.

scope: Immunoprecipitation was done from 200 μg of lysates with 6 μg of anti-CD44 antibodies

CD44-immunoprecipitants were trypsin-digested and purified using S-Trap column (Protifi). Peptides were sent to the Mass Spectrometry Resource Lab of the University of Rochester for 10-plex TMT labeling and mass spectrometry.
lysates were immunoprecipitated with CD44 antibodies and then trypsin-digested and purified with S-columns (Protifi).

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed specifically on CD44-immunoprecipitated complexes, not on whole cell lysates.
